sentences.text: Lawsonibacter asaccharolyticus, the type species, is an obligately anaerobic, Gram-positive, non-spore-forming rod isolated from the faeces of a healthy Japanese woman.
It produces acetate and butyrate as end products, and its draft genome carries genes for butyrate synthesis.
Coffee consumption was linked to the microbiome reproducibly across populations, largely through the presence and abundance of this species.
That analysis used dietary information from 22,867 participants in United States and United Kingdom cohorts, integrated with public data from 211 further cohorts.
